seo.title: Privacy policy
seo.description: How Desh Bhakt handles the information you send us.

blocks.markdown:
## What we collect

This website does not require an account. If you use the contact form we receive the name, email address and message you enter, and nothing else.

## How we use it

We use your details only to reply to you. We do not sell or share them with third parties.

## Analytics

If analytics is enabled on this site it is used only to count visits in aggregate.

## Your choices

Write to us at any time to ask us to delete your message.
